messages.subject: R962 source-only arena audit complete
messages.body: I audited the pinned native16 long-prefill allocation and lifetime plan, verified all 22 source hashes, and wrote the decision-support report. At C8192 with a 262144-cell QSA sizing assumption, GDN sets the shared region at 1,180,698,624 bytes; a Dm-only shrink does not reduce its owner, and 16K remains blocked by source guards. Pack/session-dependent ring and stage totals plus physical-context, RESTORE, quality, fault, and performance qualification remain open and are not claimed.
